item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Intel and AMD v6 with temp disk for Azure Database for PostgreSQL
item.description:
Azure Database for PostgreSQL Flexible Server is now generally available on Intel and AMD v6 compute tiers with local temporary disk. The new generation adds higher performance and larger scale options to the Flexible Server portfolio.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Intel and AMD v5 diskless tier for Azure Database for PostgreSQL
item.description:
Azure Database for PostgreSQL Flexible Server now generally available on Intel and AMD v5 diskless compute. The new General Purpose and Memory Optimized SKUs do not include local temporary storage.

  • Source: Azure Updates
